project_name.justification: The primary project is identified consistently across documents, for example: "Vior Announces Accelerated Acquisition of 100% of Former Belleterre Gold Mine" and "About the Belleterre Gold Project".

company_name.justification: The acquiring company is identified as "VIOR INC. ("Vior" or the "Corporation") (TSXV:VIO)(OTCQB:VIORF)(FRA:VL51)" in the press release.

ceo_buyer.justification: The CEO of the acquiring company is identified in the text: "Mark Fedosiewich, President and CEO of Vior Inc., commented..."

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The April 30, 2024 press release states: "Vior will pay the Concession owners a cash payment of $1 million as consideration for the transfer of the vendor's 100% interest in the Concessions."

primary_commodity.justification: The project is consistently referred to as a gold project, for example: "Vior Announces Accelerated Acquisition of 100% of Former Belleterre Gold Mine" and "About the Belleterre Gold Project".

verified_article_link.justification: This URL corresponds to the press release from April 30, 2024, which details the definitive asset purchase agreement for the Belleterre mine concessions.

currency.justification: The acquiring company, Vior Inc., is listed on the TSX Venture Exchange (TSXV) in Canada. While the currency symbol used is '$', a separate news headline in the document refers to a "C$39 MILLION PRIVATE PLACEMENT", indicating that Canadian Dollars (CAD) is the reporting currency.

cash_payments_raw.justification: The definitive agreement terms are stated as: "Under the Acquisition Agreement, Vior will pay the Concession owners a cash payment of $1 million as consideration for the transfer of the vendor's 100% interest in the Concessions."

share_payments_raw.justification: The consideration for the acquisition is explicitly stated as a cash payment, with no mention of shares being issued as part of the agreement.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The payment is explicitly defined as a cash payment, so this combined field is not applicable.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: No shares were issued as part of the acquisition consideration.

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: No warrants were mentioned as part of the acquisition consideration.

option_payments_raw.justification: No options were mentioned as part of the acquisition consideration.

issued_share_price.justification: No shares were issued as part of the acquisition consideration.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: The mention of a "+60,000m drill program" is described as a future company plan ("Vior is finalizing plans for a +60,000m drill program"), not a binding commitment made as part of the acquisition agreement terms.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: No monetary exploration commitment is mentioned as a term of the acquisition agreement.

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: The transaction terms described in the press releases do not mention any Net Smelter Royalty (NSR) being acquired or retained.

coverage_area_raw.justification: The acquisition is for "two mining concessions". The specific area of these two concessions is not stated. The document provides the total area for the consolidated Belleterre project (e.g., "348 km2"), not the area of the specific asset being acquired in this transaction.

coverage_area_unit.justification: No area value is being extracted.

resource_size.justification: The text only provides historical production figures ("produced more than 750,000oz @ 10.73g/t gold... between 1936 and 1959") and does not contain a current mineral resource estimate. The text notes the property has been "under-explored through the past 60 years".

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The press release header explicitly states the company's ticker and exchange: "Vior Inc. ('Vior' or the 'Corporation'), (TSXV:VIO)."
